plain.li: [hall] I've seen lords' halls smaller than this room.
[hall] Who built this hall, and would they build one for us?
[hall] You could hold a wedding in here and nobody would feel the walls.
[hall] Carpets, lamps and room to breathe: this place has done well.
[art] That carving stops you in your tracks.
[art] Whoever made that piece has hands I'd pay for.
[art] I'll be telling people about that statue for a season.
[graves] You keep your dead well here.
[graves] So many stones, and every one tended.
[graves] A place that marks its dead this way remembers its living too.
[shrine] I didn't expect a shrine out here.
[shrine] Your holy place is quieter than ours at home.
[walls] Nobody is walking in here uninvited.
[walls] Walls like these mean trouble has come before.
[beasts] More animals than people, and all of them fat.
[beasts] That's a herd worth stealing, if I were the type.
[fields] Fields to the horizon, and not a weed in them.
[fields] Whoever farms this land knows what they're doing.

cheerful.li: [hall] This is the finest room I've stood in all year!
[art] Now that is a piece of work.
[beasts] Look at all these beasts, you'll never go hungry.

blunt.li: [hall] Big room. Who's it meant to impress?
[walls] That's a lot of wall for a village.
[graves] That's a lot of graves for a village.

gloomy.li: [graves] So many dead, and the colony still standing.
[walls] Walls keep things out and people in.
